git add lib/weather.js test/weather.test.js && git commit -q -F - <<'EOF'
Improve error handling for API failures and malformed responses

- Include Open-Meteo's error reason in HTTP error messages
- Name the host and root cause (e.g. ENOTFOUND) on network failures,
  and report timeouts with the time limit
- Report non-JSON bodies as "Invalid JSON response from <host>"
- Fail instead of printing "undefined°C" when the temperature is
  missing; show "Unknown conditions" for a missing weather code
- Treat a null geocoding body as no match and reject results without
  numeric coordinates

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
